about_the_game:
Congratulations, you’ve just been promoted to Regional Executive Director of Trivial Assignments and Poker Expenditures (REDTAPE). Your mandate: impress C-suite executives by hitting the absurd score targets they demand.

Armed with nothing but a standard 52-card deck, you’ll build poker hands, rack up points, and survive meeting after meeting of high expectations.

Each victory earns you Clout, a corporate currency you can spend by visiting the Human Resources department to hire Employees who bend the rules in your favor, stacking passive bonuses and unique mechanics that can completely rewire your strategy.

Chain synergies, experiment with insane builds, and climb the corporate ladder of chaos. The only way past these needy bosses is by gaming the system harder than they game you.

Features:

  • 50 Employees to hire, each with unique abilities that can dramatically alter how you play.

  • 10 bosses with different strengths and weaknesses to defeat.

  • Limitless gameplay possibilites, with deck synergies to build and endless game modes.

  • Over 23 lo-fi music tracks (over an hour) to chill out to while you play.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ 64-bit / SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU, Integrated Graphics

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan‑capable GPU or integrated Apple Silicon GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
